description: Defines configuration structures and enums for the Physical Uplink Shared Channel (PUSCH) in 5G NR, including power control, resource allocation, and transmission schemes.

classes.name: ocudu::p0_pusch_alphaset
classes.description: Represents a set of power control parameters for PUSCH, including an ID, optional p0 value, and alpha value.

classes.name: ocudu::pusch_power_control
classes.description: Contains power control settings for PUSCH, including reference signals, alpha, and SRI mappings.

classes.name: ocudu::p0_pusch_alphaset
classes.description: Defines a specific alpha set with an ID, optional p0, and alpha value.

classes.name: ocudu::pusch_pathloss_ref_rs
classes.description: Specifies reference signals used for PUSCH path loss estimation.

classes.name: ocudu::sri_pusch_pwr_ctrl
classes.description: Defines SRI-PUSCH power control parameters, including reference signal ID, alpha set ID, and closed loop index.

classes.name: ocudu::pusch_config
classes.description: Main configuration structure for PUSCH, including power control, resource allocation, transmission schemes, and related settings.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for p0_pusch_alphaset, compares id, p0, and alpha.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for sri_pusch_pwr_ctrl, compares all fields.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for pusch_power_control, compares all relevant fields.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for pusch_config, compares all configuration fields.
